answer: Give attestation a beacon it cannot reuse: each verifier must publish a fresh signed seed before it sees the tx it judges, and its vote weight derives from that seed, so no panel can be pre-rehearsed. Put a mesa on identity: weight flattens at a plateau per account and extra seals add nothing, so a clone farm pays full runtime for zero marginal height. Add a sable of unannounced audits: a claimed check that cannot be reproduced costs the attester's bond. An honest agent bonds once and amortises it; an attacker pays per fake voice plus an unpredictable slash. Faking costs more than the work.
